_comment: WPForms > Tools > AI MCP tab — the real Enable MCP Write Access toggle in its OFF (default) state. Needed by a Claude short's beat ('Write access OFF by default') so the beat shows real UI instead of an editorial toggle chip. Write access flipped to false via site-eval before capture and restored after.

steps.eval: const t = document.querySelector('#wpforms-ai-mcp-write-toggle'); if (!t) { throw new Error('write toggle missing'); } if (t.checked) { throw new Error('write toggle is ON - expected OFF for this capture'); }
